facts.assertion: Enfield announced on 11 March 2026 that construction of Meridian One A was complete.
Meridian One A delivered 301 homes in Edmonton.
The March 2026 completion announcement records 273 completed affordable homes at Meridian One A.
Enfield describes the affordable share at Meridian One A as 90% on the project to date.
Meridian One A is described as the first fully completed residential neighbourhood within Meridian Water.
The completed Meridian One A partnership involved Enfield Council, Vistry and Sage Homes.
The Meridian One A completion announcement also identifies a skills academy, play area and community facilities as delivered elements.
Vistry's statement in the March 2026 council announcement anticipated returning to site later in 2026 for a further circa 700 homes.
Enfield's current schemes page states Meridian Water aims to deliver 10,000 homes over the lifetime of the programme.
The current Meridian Water programme also aims to create thousands of jobs.
Enfield's December 2025 Meridian Two update describes 274 affordable homes and 3,000 square metres of commercial space.
The Meridian Two project value was stated as £92 million in the council's December 2025 update.
The Meridian Two site is described as a former gas site on Leeside Road in Edmonton.
Enfield's December 2025 update says Leeside Road forms part of Phase Two, which is expected eventually to deliver up to 2,000 homes.
A September 2025 Enfield update says Strategic Infrastructure Works would open more than 30 acres of land.
The same September 2025 update linked those infrastructure works to more than 1,500 homes and 400,000 square feet of business space being capable of acceleration from 2026.
Enfield's current Meridian Water compulsory-purchase page says Phase 2 is expected to deliver up to 2,300 homes with 28,500 square metres of commercial space.
The current CPO page records that Strategic Infrastructure Works planning permission was approved in July 2020.
The same page records a Planning Committee resolution on 11 March 2021 to grant Phase 2 permission subject to conditions and a Section 106 agreement.
Different published Meridian Water phase totals describe different project scopes and dates; none is treated as candidate 30762 parcel membership without authoritative geometry intersection.
